title: The King of Fighters '98
note: Name of the character currently fighting next to P1, P2 or CPU (team read from RAM, FBNeo cheat codes).

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

health_p2.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

_time_sub.note: the timer's fraction of a second (RetroAchievements code notes, 0xa83a Timer: Millseconds), it moves at every frame once the round's timer runs, FIGHT ! waits for it to come with the game's own FIGHT or GO (1.31.1)

_fight_state.note: the state of the fight, as in The King of Fighters '97 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0xa787 Fight - State: 0x18 Ready, 0x1a fighting; the MAME cheat Hide Background reads it as not 0 during a match); READY at 0x18, FIGHT ! with GO 1.15 s later (1.31.1, Seb's video); Seb's log (1.32 test 8b): 0x1A during the fight (0x02 a moment in a super's freeze), 0x18 also at TIME UP, 0x19 and 0x01 by turns after a K.O. then 0x01, 0 when the next round's intro starts (ROUND n) and between the select screens and a first round; its changes written in the log

score.note: player 1 score, found with learn.bat (RetroArch, FinalBurn Neo)

score_p2.note: player 2 score, found with learn.bat (RetroArch, FinalBurn Neo)

beat.note: VS match, player 1 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat=...)

beat_p2.note: VS match, player 2 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat2=...)

round.note: round of the match, from 0, one more at each K.O. (cheat database "Select Current Round", 1 to 6; it was read as the match number and shown as STAGE n, but Seb saw it move at each K.O. in 1.31), shown as ROUND n when the next fight begins

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Japan (Street), 1 China, 2 Korea, 3 Mid-East, 4 Spain, 5 USA (Yard), 6 Japan (Temple), 7 USA (Wharf), 8 Blacknoah. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

_screen.note: the screen the game shows (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x8502 Screen ID (16bits), 77b2 = Character selection screen, b3a0 = Order select, e8be = Fighting); its select screens give VS and no event of a fight; 0xE8BE only comes once the fight runs, after GO (Seb's video, 1.32 test 8)

_in_p1.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 1 (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right, 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D, 1 = pressed), read at every frame ("fast") for the desperation moves under the name (1.32); read the other way round if up and down show together

_in_p2.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 2, same bits

_pow.note: P1 power gauge (RetroAchievements code notes, a0 = full), the bar of the panel under the name (1.32)

_pow_p2.note: P2 power gauge, the P1 one + 0x200 (the player blocks of the game), to confirm

_stock.note: P1 stocks in Advanced mode, the green squares of the panel (MAME cheat Infinite Power writes it), to confirm with learn.bat (stock=0, stock=1, stock=2); its changes written in the log (1.32)

_stock_p2.note: P2 stocks in Advanced mode, the P1 one + 0x200, to confirm

_pmode.note: P1 mode chosen before the match, 0 Advanced, 1 Extra (next to the team, _p1_lost + 0x01 below it); its changes written in the log (1.32), to confirm

_pmode_p2.note: P2 mode, the P1 one + 0x11 as the teams, to confirm

_maxv.note: P1 MAX timer of Advanced: the MAME cheat Infinite Power holds it at 0x40; in Seb's log the CPU's MAX set it to 0x3F and it counted down, a desperation move or a guard cancel only to 0x01, the next round back to 0; MAX while it is at 2 or more, whatever the buttons (1.32 test 8c)

_maxv_p2.note: P2 MAX timer of Advanced, the P1 one + 0x200 (0x3F at the CPU's MAX in Seb's log)

select.note: 1 on the character select and the order select (0x77B2, 0xB3A0); the screens between them and the first round, and after a match, have no fight going (_fight_state 0) and are select screens too for ArcadeDMD, the next rounds' intros start at 0 after a K.O. (0x19 and 0x01) (Seb's log, 1.32 test 8b)

moves.note: desperation moves of each fighter (DM), shown under the name when the gauge allows one (1.32): numpad notation for a fighter facing right, P any punch, K any kick, a letter for one button; from the MAME command.dat (Progetto-SNAPS, kof98 entry) checked against the Korean Enha wiki, both for the original game; EX and Orochi versions not here

buttons.note: names of the buttons on the HD screen (1.32), A light punch, B light kick, C heavy punch, D heavy kick, as Seb asked

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), and the place shown under ROUND 1 (the backdrops of the cheat database), see README, HD themes
